title: Great Fun & Memorable Souvenir!
text: We did the two hour session and this was the perfect time to enjoy creating and completing our project without feeling rushed.  Excellent, helpful and friendly teachers.  We had all supplies needed and a good selection of designs for all to complete a very nice, lasting, useful souvenir.  All ages were present (4-70), participated, and enjoyed very much!  Great fun and highly recommend!  Would definitely recommend and would do again when in Barcelona!
author: Kathleen_O

title: Excellent tour! Our guide...
text: Excellent tour! Our guide was great, despite the poor weather. He was highly knowledgeable and personable!
author: Jacqueline_O

title: Amazing experience!
text: I had a great experience making a Gaudi-inspired picture frame. The staff were very attentive and helpful. I’m so glad I chose this experience. I will do it again when I return!
author: tierney_h

title: Amazing experience with my 7 year old experiencing Mosaic Art
text:
Such a great experience at Mosaiccos today. Booked a 2 hour session with my 7 year old daughter and she absolutely loved it. Got some amazing Barcelona souvenirs to take home. The staff were so nice and helpful and they were able get everything ready within the day (as we fly out the following day). Highly recommended activity while in Barcelona.
Thank you so much!!
author: HayatoK3

title: Highly recommend: a lot of fun
text: Excellent. We loved the experience and the instructors. We had a lot of fun and came away with cute little mosaics. I would highly recommend this!!!

title: Great experience!
